settings_description: Choose language, time zone, first day of the week and clock. Only the display changes; saved dates and times stay as they are. Nobody else sees these settings.
settings_unsaved_hint: Fields you have not saved yet show values suggested from this browser's language and time zone.
settings_doc_font_hint: Applies to this browser only. Serif downloads its typeface once when you open a document.
settings_theme_hint: Saved to your account, so every device matches.
